message.content:
# Design Review: Home Screen (390px) — Healthcare Booking App

## 1) Visual Hierarchy
- **City selector is buried at the footer** as a plain "📍 Delhi · change" text line. Location is critical in healthcare booking (it drives which doctors/hospitals show), yet it's the least prominent element on screen. This is inverted priority.
- The **stats line ("97 doctors · 13 hospitals · 63 visits booked — live")** sits above section content and competes with real content. It's marketing metadata, not navigation — it draws the eye before the doctor cards do.
- Search bar is the only strong focal point at top — that part works.
- "₹300 / visit" stacks into a ragged two-line block on the card, pulling attention away from the doctor's name.

## 2) Spacing & Alignment
- **Vertical rhythm is uneven**: tight spacing between search → chips → stats, then a large void before "Doctors," then another oversized gap before "Hospitals," then a **massive dead zone between footer links and the bottom nav** (~200px of empty space). The page looks like content ends and nothing filled the rest.
- **Right margin is broken**: the second doctor card, second hospital card, and the "acidity" chip are all **clipped at the 390px edge**. This is acceptable only if it's a deliberate carousel with a visible peek — but there's no partial-card peek cue done correctly; text inside the clipped cards is **truncated mid-word ("Dr. QA…", "QA Br…")**, which reads as broken, not scrollable.
- Fee "₹300 visit" wraps — inconsistent with single-line name/specialty/city rows; baseline misalignment between avatar and text block.

## 3) Touch Targets
- Symptom chips ≈ ok height, but the clipped "acidity" chip's tap area runs off-screen.
- "change" city link and "Privacy / Terms" are small text-only targets (~14px text, no padding) — below 44px minimum.
- Footer version line is not a target at all but is styled ambiguously close to links.

## 4) Information Scent
- A new user sees search + chips — decent entry point. But **nothing tells them what tapping a chip does** (filter? search? booking?).
- **No CTA on cards** — no "Book" button or chevron. A first-time user can't tell cards are actionable.
- "• live" badge on "Doctors" header is unexplained — live what? Doctors don't go live; it duplicates the "live" in the stats line. Ambiguous and redundant.

## 5) Visual Polish — Real, Visible Defects
1. "General Phy…" — specialty truncated with ellipsis on the very first card; bad first impression.
2. "₹300 / visit" wrapped onto two lines, misaligned with name row.
3. "Dr. QA" and "QA Br" truncated names — looks like data loading failure.
4. "0 doctors · 1 departm…" truncated in hospital card meta.
5. **"Aturseva v0.3.0 · APK-B10"** — an internal build string exposed in production UI. Clearly unfinished.
6. Bottom nav labels appear clipped at the bottom edge ("Home" partially cut).
7. Generic gray-circle initial avatars ("R", "DQ", "CH", "QB") with no photos — acceptable as fallback but combined with everything else it reads as stub content.
8. Duplicate "live" indicators (stats line + section pill).

## 6) Healthcare Restraint
- Palette is calm, no alarming reds, no stock imagery, no dark patterns. This dimension is fine.

---

## VERDICT: **FAIL**

Blocking issues: horizontally clipped/truncated cards and chips at the right edge, truncated content on the first card in each section, exposed APK build string, dead vertical space before the nav, buried city selector, and missing affordance/CTA on cards. Fix the horizontal overflow and truncation first — everything else is secondary to the screen currently looking broken.
message.reasoning_content: Audit the screenshot. Real defects: symptom chips clipped at right edge ("acidity" cut off, no horizontal scroll affordance); doctor card clipped — "Dr. QA..." truncated and card cut off, no scroll indicator; hospital card "QA Br..." clipped; fee "₹300 visit" wrapping into two lines with awkward alignment; truncated specialty "General Phy…"; city selector buried at bottom as plain text — weak; "live" badge duplicated (stats line and Doctors header) redundant; live pill alignment; Hospitals "See all" pill — touch target fine; bottom nav labels clipped ("Home" partially cut, Profile label near edge); footer takes huge empty space with version "APK-B10" dev build string visible — unfinished; missing search icon contrast okay; chips lack icons but fine. No greeting/section intro. Spacing between Doctors and Hospitals sections large vs tight elsewhere. Card margins asymmetric (right card clipped). Verdict FAIL.
